knowledgeProposal.title: Site copy rules
knowledgeProposal.note: Three rules that came out of rewriting the homepage, so the next person writing for the site does not have to rediscover them.
knowledgeProposal.description: The three rules every sentence on the public site follows, and the reason for each.
knowledgeProposal.html:
Site copy rules

Three rules every sentence on the public site follows. They came out of rewriting the homepage on 6 September.

1. Say the outcome, not the feature

“Get the finished work back” beats “watch the work come back”. A visitor is buying a result, not a show.

2. One promise per sentence

If a sentence needs an “and”, it is two sentences.

3. Never claim what a reader can check and find false

See the brand-voice page for the list of claims we never make. If the honest version is weaker, write the honest version.

knowledgePages.title: Brand voice
knowledgePages.description: How Northstar Studio sounds in writing: warm, plain, outcomes first, and the words we do not use.
knowledgePages.html:
Brand voice

Northstar Studio sounds like a colleague who is glad to see you: warm, plain, and specific.

Say outcomes

  • One shared workspace, not a folder of chats
  • Named coworkers who remember last week
  • An approval card in front of anything that ships

Words we do not use

Instead ofSay
leverageuse
seamless(say what actually happens)
revolutionary(nothing — show it)

Claims we never make

Anything a reader can check and find false. If the honest version is weaker, write the honest version.
